identity.name: Streamliner Centre Seconds Smoked Salmon
identity.one_liner: The H. Moser Streamliner — 40mm steel integrated bracelet, smoked salmon dial, in-house automatic — the most-cited Asian-friendly independent haute piece of the early 2020s.

provenance_events.description: H. Moser & Cie releases the Streamliner Centre Seconds — a 40mm steel integrated bracelet watch with the in-house HMC 200 automatic movement and a fumé smoked salmon dial.

narrative.story: The Streamliner is H. Moser's integrated-bracelet steel watch — the brand's answer to the Royal Oak and Nautilus, at a more accessible price. The HMC 200 is a 3-day automatic with a free-sprung balance, hand-finished to haute horlogerie standards.
narrative.collector_notes: The Streamliner is one of the most-cited Asian haute pieces of the 2020s. The fumé dial is a Moser signature: each colour (Salmon, Cosmic Green, Purity) is a one-off recipe.
